reviews.title: Samsung Monitor
reviews.comment: I've been using this monitor recently and I simply love it. I love the visual display and how easy it is to navigate through it. The sound has great quality as well. The main reason why I got this monitor was for school work which has been a little difficult for me to try to set up but all the other features work amazing and I don't regret making this purchase.
reviews.author: Ivan

reviews.title: True all in one QDOLED
reviews.comment: Love it for PC productivity and gaming! Wanted a high refresh rate OLED 4k monitor with speakers and this hit all the boxes! Having major streaming apps built in is great, but it does shove some serious bloatware (Samsung Smart Things, Alexa etc) in your face. With some work you can get rid of all the ads and crappy apps from the home screen and it becomes a great experience! Every AI feature is hot garbage but we all knew that was gonna be the case. All the setup and headache was worth it because it is truly the best looking screen I’ve ever owned!
reviews.author: Henry
